entries.title: Open L-Colonnade and Rest Corner
entries.description: One static open L-shaped colonnade corner: five complete unit-scale copies of one published fluted stone column define a turning inner walk, with a complete original slatted bench in a connected side rest pocket. All original column and bench geometry, nodes and solid PBR remain unchanged. Two closed scene-only meshes provide a chamfered stone ground and exact bedding under all four complete tilted bench-foot patches. Six bounded empty volumes connect the front entry, two colonnade walks, east return, central turn and bench-front space. One scene, zero new independent models; repeated columns are instances of one old model. No beam, roof, arch or covered corridor is included. The .15m outer base step needs external placement. Static game appearance only; no historical order, archaeological reconstruction, structural, load, stability, manufacturing, safety, accessibility, controller, navigation or old-module compatibility certification.
